prior: R13 frozen carried estimator estimated a correction *relative to a moving measured latch frame* but scored it as a change relative to normal pickup. On exposed R13 pairs, adding the pre-existing latch-to-teach bottom term before differencing fitted the observed change more closely. Paired zero/truth is not available at inference. R13 prior results remain recorded and are not validation.
design: Two arms use same new calibration and test cases: passive R1 with R10 detector or 1.5-deg compact body-pitch sine (3 cycles, world translation exactly held at nominal TCP) at 1.98--3.40s. Taught reference/TCP, grip/switches/plant/evaluator and later motion unchanged. Probe is research only and is NOT applied to physical hardware. Compare to unmodified R1, never to a moved score reference.
estimator: Same causal R13 joint inverse dynamics correction, plus the downward box extent in the measured latch pose, minus normal expectation fitted vs known payload mass only from that mode/arm calibration recordings. Normal baseline evaluated from internally fitted normal absolute values; leave-one-record-out recomputes both. No true box pose, actual offsets, nuisance settings or per-test matched-zero in predictions. Block/fold estimates and normal LOO define an empirical guard; also report original unregistered and offline paired errors.
uncertainty: 0.75 mm fixed geometry margin + largest abs leave-one-calibration-out normal predicted change + largest of five 80ms-block deletion changes. Keep R13 width <=2.5 mm, interval excludes zero, within calibration and displacement support. No probabilistic coverage claim. Also evaluate an interval-soft robust action separately: subtract envelope from magnitude (zero if interval contains zero), never claim this replaces the strict sign or RMSE gates.

gates.identification: For each mode/arm report original R13 strict metric: 8/8 correct and accepted including sub-resolution changes, point RMSE <=2mm, max control error <=2mm, no accepted intervals miss. Separately for actual control, nominal or active arm: across all 16 records point RMSE <=2 mm, max error of applied (zero if abstention) <=2mm, no accepted interval misses, no action for |truth|<1mm, and correct action in >=75% of |truth|>=2.5mm with every such error <=2mm. Tiny changes need not be acted on but are included in max-error and all-sample metrics; a failure stays a failure. No test-case-specific threshold or retries. Report both gates even if different.
gates.movement: Probe must hold nominal reference TCP to 1e-8m and stay within velocity limits. In all 16 two-arm physical pairs/mode: whole-cycle original TCP RMS/max ratios <=1.05, zero added saturation, no new false alarm count or additional tool-contact event, peak placement force and torque jitter <=1.05 relative to identical passive condition. No energy, bandwidth or hardware guarantee. If the probe fails do not use it in control.
gates.next: Only if the functional gate passes on a mode and chosen excitation satisfies motion limits may qualified estimates drive a separately frozen R12 hybrid with new cases and complete G4/collisions; prefer passive if it meets goal. If not, keep R10 and report which term or uncertainty dominates. No threshold optimization on held truths.
